definition.name: Mix_GPS
definition.definition: Mix(A) reduction — the mixed-state tomography algorithm obtained from any pure-state tomography algorithm A: Given n copies of a rank-r mixed state rho in C^{d x d}, (1) apply the purification channel Phi^{d,r} to obtain a state equivalent to n copies of a random purification |rho_bar> in C^d tensor C^r, (2) run the pure-state algorithm A on these n copies to obtain an estimate |v> in C^{d*r}, (3) output rho_hat = tr_2(|v><v|) (partial trace over the ancilla). For A = GPS, the resulting estimator Mix(GPS) outputs rho_hat_v = tr_2(sigma_hat_v) where sigma_hat_v is the GPS estimate for the purification.
